statuses.na: Not ours to map. Another school's course, or otherwise out of scope.
statuses.tbd: The AoL instrument for this GA has not been settled yet.
statuses.identified: Course and assessment agreed. Rubric work not started.
statuses.rubric_in_dev: Rubric being built or revised to carry all three GA criteria.
statuses.partial_mapping: Rubric is live and marked as AoL, but carries fewer than three GA criteria.
statuses.built_awaiting_coordinator: Rubric carries all three criteria and has been sent. Coordinator sign-off outstanding.
statuses.approved_not_installed: Coordinator has approved the rubric. Not yet applied in a live offering.
statuses.awaiting_ld_check: A rubric with all three criteria was found live in the course. The learning designer has not confirmed it yet.
statuses.active: Rubric carries all three criteria and is in use in a live offering.
